description: Return one exact model, its live input schema, pricing, policy and availability. Reuse a complete record already obtained from models_list with includeSchema. The input schema is plain JSON Schema; display-only and rate-card annotations are removed. Some input values change the price; task_create obtains the exact request quote for confirmation. Use pricing entries for comparisons rather than calculating the accepted charge yourself.
name: spicyapi_model_get

mature.description: Informational model capability metadata; not a platform routing or access gate.

policyTier.description: Informational model policy metadata; not a platform routing or access gate. Known values: unrestricted, borderline, softened, filtered, unspecified. softened means the model quietly returns a toned-down result and the task is still charged. Treat the set as open and ignore a value you do not recognise.

unit.description: Known values: per_image, per_second, per_request, per_1k_tokens, per_1k_characters. Treat the set as open and ignore a value you do not recognise.
